oly.translation: abbr. Washington, D. C. , Olympics 华盛顿奥运会（国家协会）

olylnpian forehead.translation: [医] 宽凸前额(见于先天性梅毒)

olympe.translation: n. (Olympe)人名；(法)奥兰普(女子教名)

olympia.definition:
n. capital of the state of Washington; located in western Washington on Puget Sound
n. a plain in Greece in the northwestern Peloponnese; the chief sanctuary of Zeus and the site of the original Olympian Games

olympia oyster.translation: 【动物】奥林匹亚牡蛎(产于美国西北部海峡)

olympiad.definition: n. one of the four-year intervals between Olympic Games; used to reckon time in ancient Greece for twelve centuries beginning in 776 BC
olympiad.translation: n. (四年一次的)奥林匹克世界运动大会, 四年周期

olympian.definition:
n. an athlete who participates in the Olympic games
n. a classical Greek god after the overthrow of the Titans
a. of the region of Olympia in Greece or its inhabitants
olympian.translation: a. 威严的；奥林匹克竞赛的；奥林匹斯山的

olympian zeus.translation: [网络] 奥林匹亚的宙斯；宙斯神；奥林匹亚宙斯庙

olympians.definition:
n. an athlete who participates in the Olympic games
n. a classical Greek god after the overthrow of the Titans
olympians.translation: n. 奥运会选手; <主美>奥运会选手( Olympian的复数形式 )

olympic.definition: a. of or relating to the Olympic Games
olympic.translation: a. 奥林匹亚的, 奥林匹斯山的, 强有力的, 巨大的

olympic mountains.translation: 奥林匹克山（美国华盛顿州西北部山脉）

olympic national park.translation: [网络] 奥林匹克国家公园；奥林匹克半岛；时间充裕可以去国家公园

olympics.definition: n the modern revival of the ancient games held once every 4 years in a selected country

olympics withdrawal.definition:
the comedown felt by an Olympics host city when the games are over
> The city seems gripped by Olympics withdrawal. Our sports-crack is all gone.

olympus.definition: n. a mountain peak in northeast Greece near the Aegean coast; believed by ancient Greeks to be the dwelling place of the gods (9,570 feet high)
olympus.translation: n. 奥林匹斯山, 天堂

olynthus.translation: n. 奥林索斯（古希腊一座城市）

olyphant.translation: [人名] 奥利芬特; [地名] [美国] 奥利凡特
